transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi... thank you so much for seeing me. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

Um, I guess I'm here because... well, for the last couple of years, I've just been feeling a bit low all the time? I mean, I know everyone gets sad, and I really don't want to sound ungrateful or complain too much. But even when I'm at work doing my inspections, or at church, or around people I really care about... there's just this heavy, kind of empty feeling that doesn't really lift. 

Is that... is that okay to say? I just hope that makes sense.
How long have you been feeling this low mood?

Um... well, it's been a while. I'd say... maybe about two years and four months? Give or take? I really hope I'm not making a bigger deal out of it than it is. 

It kind of started back when I had to... um... when I had to stop taking my classes at the community college. It was just getting too hard with money, and my work schedule doing the inspecting and sorting was just a lot to balance. I feel kind of silly even mentioning it, because I know people work and go to school all the time and handle it just fine... but I guess that's when this feeling really settled in. 

Is... is that the kind of information you need? I hope I'm answering your questions okay.
Do you find that you're still able to enjoy activities or hobbies that you used to like before you started feeling this low mood?

Um... I try to, I really do. I don't want you to think I'm just giving up or anything. But... I guess I haven't been doing much of what I used to like. I used to go to basketball and dance nights, and I was really involved in this STEM mentoring program at my church. I really cared about it... but I've mostly stopped showing up to all of it. I feel so bad about letting them down. 

And, um... I'm really embarrassed to even say this, because I know how important my job is and I really want to be a good employee, but... I've actually gotten some written warnings at work lately. I've been missing shifts and turning in my inspection documentation late. I know I need to do better, I really do. 

Does... does that make sense? I hope it doesn't just sound like I'm being lazy.
Do you still find pleasure in the activities you do manage to participate in?

Um... I guess not really? I mean, I try to act like I'm having a good time, especially at church, because I don't want to bring anyone else down. But... even when I'm there, or when I'm trying to do something fun, it just feels kind of... flat? Like I'm just going through the motions. 

I'm sorry, I know that sounds terrible. I really do try to find the good in things, I promise. I just... I don't know why I can't just enjoy things like normal people do. Is that... is that something you hear a lot? I hope I'm not the only one who feels this way.
Do you often feel worried or anxious about things?

Um... not really? I mean, I wouldn't say I'm a super worried person. I stress a little bit about, you know, doing a good job at work and trying not to let my supervisor down, especially since I've been behind on my sorting and testing lately... but I don't think I get panicky or anything like that. 

It's mostly just that heavy, sad feeling I mentioned before. I hope that's okay? Like, is it normal to just feel down without being super nervous about things all the time? I really want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?

Um... I don't think I've lost interest, exactly? Like, I still care about those things a whole lot. I really do. Especially the mentoring program... I still think about it all the time and I want them to do well. 

It's not that I don't care anymore, it's just... like I was saying before, I just haven't been going. I still want to be involved, I just haven't been able to make myself actually get up and go do it. I hope that doesn't sound like I'm just making excuses? I really want you to know I still value those things, I'm just struggling to show up. 

Does that... does that answer what you were asking? I want to make sure I'm explaining it right.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

Um... I guess maybe a little bit? I mean, nothing too extreme, I promise. It's just... I've noticed my work pants fit kind of differently from month to month. Sometimes they're a little tight, sometimes they're loose. 

I think it's just because my eating habits have been a little all over the place lately. Most days, I just don't have much of an appetite, so I'll kind of skip eating until my shift is almost over because nothing really sounds good. But then sometimes I get so drained that I just end up grabbing snacks from the vending machine late at night. 

I know that's not the healthiest way to eat, and I'm really trying to be better about it, I swear. I don't want you to think I'm just completely letting myself go. Is it... is it pretty common for people's weight to fluctuate a little bit when they're feeling like this? I hope I'm not doing too badly.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt better, without this low mood, that lasted for several months?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think so? It feels like this heavy feeling has just kind of... always been there, at least for a really long time. 

I mean, I have good days! I promise I do. I smile at work and I try really hard to be pleasant with everyone, I don't want to bring anyone down. But even on the okay days, that sort of sad, drained feeling is still humming in the background, you know? 

I can't really remember a time recently where it was just... completely gone for months at a time. I hope that's not a bad sign? I really try to stay positive, I just... I haven't been able to shake it completely. Am I... is that the kind of answer you were looking for?
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness?

Um... I wouldn't say I'm completely unable to feel happy. I really don't want to sound like I'm just miserable all the time, because I'm not. 

Like I said, I do have okay days. Sometimes if I'm at work and one of the other inspectors tells a joke, I still laugh, and it feels nice for a minute. Or if I'm watching a show I like, I can kind of enjoy it. It's just... I guess the happy feeling doesn't really stick around very long? It's like it's there, but it's sort of muted, maybe? 

I still try really hard to appreciate the good things, I promise. I don't want to seem ungrateful. It's just a little harder to hold onto that feeling lately. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or the way you move?

Um... I guess maybe I have been a little more tired lately? But I really try not to let it show at work, I swear. I always make sure I get my job done. 

It's just... I don't know, it feels like even the really small stuff takes so much more effort than it used to? Like, just filling out the inspection logs at the end of my shift, or driving to basketball, or even just... washing my hair. It just feels like it takes more energy than I actually have. 

And I try to rest on my days off, I really do. I'll just stay in bed and try to recharge, but it doesn't really seem to refill me the way it's supposed to. I know I probably just need to push through it better, and I'm really trying to. I don't want you to think I'm just being lazy or anything like that. Is it normal to feel this drained when you're dealing with this kind of stuff? I hope I'm not complaining too much.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?

Um... no. No, definitely not. I've never had anything like that happen. 

I know that's a really important question you guys have to ask, but I promise I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I'm just... dealing with the sad feelings and being tired, that's all. My mind is totally clear otherwise, I swear. 

I hope you don't think I'm, like, crazy or anything for being here? I'm just trying to get a little help so I can be better at work and everything. But no, nothing like voices or hallucinations. I'm okay on that front, I promise.
How long has this current episode of feeling low lasted?

Um... well, it's been a while, I guess. I really hope I haven't let it go on for too long before getting help... I didn't want to be a bother, you know? 

But, um, I think it's been about two years and four months now? It kind of started around the time I had to stop taking my community college classes. I just couldn't make the money work with my schedule at the plant, so I had to put school on hold. 

I really tried to just stay positive about it and focus on my job, I promise I did. I didn't want to just give up or anything. But I guess that's when things started feeling... heavier? I hope it's okay that I waited this long to come in. I just kept thinking I could handle it on my own if I tried hard enough.
Have you had any periods in your life where you didn't feel this low mood for at least two months?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think so. I really tried to snap out of it, I promise I did. But since I had to stop classes... it's just kind of been there the whole time. 

I mean, I have good days! I don't want you to think I'm just miserable all the time or complaining. I still go to work and do my best, and sometimes I'll have a decent day at the plant. But the heavy feeling... it hasn't ever really gone away for more than a few days at a time. Definitely not for two whole months. 

I hope that's an okay answer? I know I should probably be doing a better job of pulling myself together, and I'm really sorry if it sounds like I haven't been trying. I just haven't been able to shake it off for that long. Is that... is that normal for someone in my situation?
Have you had more than one episode of feeling low like this in your life?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, before I had to leave school, I was doing okay. I was busy, you know, but I felt alright. 

This is really the first time I've felt this... stuck. I mean, I've had days where I was sad before, like normal sad, but nothing that lasted like this. I've always been pretty good at just putting my head down and getting through things. 

I hope that makes sense? I'm trying to be really accurate for you. I just... I haven't had this happen before. I really hope that means it'll be easier to fix? I just want to get back to doing a good job at work and not feeling so tired all the time.
Have you had any other episodes of feeling low like this before the one that started two years and four months ago?

Um... no, not that I can remember. Like I said, I was doing pretty okay before all the school stuff happened. I've always tried to be the kind of person who just deals with things, you know? 

I really hope I'm not repeating myself too much, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. But yeah, before two years ago, I didn't feel like this. I was just working at the plant and going to classes and... it was fine. I didn't have any of this heavy feeling. Is that helpful? I hope I'm explaining it right.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt completely back to your normal self for at least two months before this current episode started?

Um... well, before all of this started two years ago, I was just... normal, I guess? So yeah, my whole life before that was basically just me being my normal self. 

I mean, I hope that's what you're asking? I didn't have any periods of feeling like this back then, so I was just... me. Doing my classes, working at the plant, trying to be a good student and a good worker. I really tried to keep everything balanced back then, I promise I did. 

Is that what you needed to know? I just want to make sure I'm answering it the way you need me to. I'm really trying to be helpful.
Have you ever felt low like this before the episode that started two years and four months ago, and then gotten better for a while before it came back?

Um... no, definitely not. Like I was saying, before everything kind of fell apart a couple of years ago, I was totally fine. I didn't have any times where I felt this down and then got better and then got worse again. 

I really hope I'm being clear? I don't want to confuse you or make it seem like I'm changing my story. I just... I was my regular self, working and going to school, and then this feeling started and it just never really went away. 

I'm sorry if I'm not explaining it well enough. I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to help figure this out. Am I doing okay with these questions?
Have you had any periods where you felt completely back to your normal self for at least two months since this low mood started two years and four months ago?

Um... no, not really. Since it started, it's just been... kind of a constant thing. I haven't really had any breaks where I felt totally normal again, not for two months anyway. I mean, I've tried really hard to push through it and, you know, still do my job and everything. I don't want you to think I'm just giving up or anything. 

I just... the heavy feeling is always kind of there in the background, even when I'm trying my best to ignore it. I hope that makes sense? I'm sorry, I know that's probably not the answer you were hoping for. I'm really trying to get better, I promise. Is that... is that the kind of information you need?
Have you had any periods of at least two months without this low mood since it started two years and four months ago?

Um... no, no I haven't. I'm sorry, I know you just asked me that, I hope I'm not being repetitive or annoying. It's just... yeah, no two-month breaks or anything like that. It's just been pretty much the same since it started. 

I really wish I could tell you yes, that I had a good stretch where everything was completely fine. I know that would probably mean I'm doing better, and I want to be doing better, I really do. I'm trying to do everything right. But... no, it hasn't gone away for that long. 

Does that... I mean, does that make sense? I hope I'm answering this the right way for you.
Has this current episode of low mood lasted for more than two years?

Um... yes. Yes, it has. I know we've kind of touched on the timeline already, and I really hope I'm not making things difficult by repeating myself. But yes, it's been about two years and four months now. 

It all started around the time I had to stop taking my community college classes. I just... I couldn't make it work with the money, and my shifts at the plant were so unpredictable. I didn't want to drop out, I really tried to keep up with everything, but I just couldn't manage it all. That's when this whole feeling really settled in. 

I hope it's okay that I brought up the school thing? I just want to make sure you have the whole picture of when this started. Am I giving you the right kind of details?
